rationale: Build on the current recurrent-tail QK-rescued best with a minimal EvoNAS-style state-carryover transplant. Each recurrent tail block now gets a zero-init learned carry gate that blends the live state toward that block's first-pass tail state before the shared recurrent re-application. This keeps shapes and step structure unchanged, adds only tiny control tensors that stay FP32, preserves the exact final int8+zlib path, and directly tests whether gated tail-state reuse compounds with the existing tail QK float budget under the 600s Mac-mini regime.
title: Carry-Gated Input Anchor On Recurrent Tail QK Best
